intel_cpu_suite_qualification.decision: Only the persistent real CPU suite uses the independently qualified Intel host executable to reduce qualification time. No speedup is inferred or claimed. GNU native-mini, request-order proofs, native real-controller comparisons and captures retain their existing identities.
intel_cpu_suite_qualification.preflight: Before launch, all five Intel modes must pass 8-token/384-fixture checks against the current Intel binary and their actual prerequisite dispatch-p33 hash. The intended suite dispatch-p38 hash is separate and its current CPU kernel source/binary/child receipts plus full-array dual-compiler capacity qualification are required. Qualification plan persists both dispatch identities before launch.
intel_cpu_suite_qualification.export: Both rank executable paths must be the Intel host path; every request binary hash must match that binary; compiler/executable/hash are exported explicitly.
intel_cpu_suite_qualification.seal: Separate Intel suite hash/path; GNU host_sha unchanged. Seal checks qualification plan hash, separate p33 prerequisite and p38 suite dispatch hashes, five mode receipt hashes and both p38 kernel qualification receipts.
intel_cpu_suite_qualification.prior_refusal: Initial preflight incorrectly expected p38 for real-mode receipts actually measured under p33; parent preserved refusal. No rank launched. Dispatch identities are now separate; the actual preflight passes.
